env_jobs_tradeoff.why: No examples of the rules or jobs at stake.
env_jobs_tradeoff.scope: Industries like coal and metal mining, oil and gas, and manufacturing. Rules like limits on mine runoff, smokestack emissions and drilling near water supplies.

permitting_tradeoff.scope: Projects of any kind of energy. Reviews study effects on wildlife, water, air and nearby residents, and today can take 4 years or more for major projects.

options.0: Require fast, deep cuts in greenhouse gas emissions, such as halving them within 10 years, even if energy prices rise noticeably
